chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Benny Goodman hears the band; Fletcher Henderson on the road
summary: Goodman, Shaw and others watched Webb's band on Saturday nights; Chick's band avoided Fletcher's best-known numbers when they met on the road.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Because he was writing most of the arrangements with (inaudible). And they had -- And so I -- One Saturday night, I say, "Hey, why don't you play "Stompin At The Savoy"? I never played that." So they played "Stompin At The Savoy," and it went over big, you know. And we started playing it, you know. Now if you notice on the record, you see Benny Goodman's name on "Stompin At The Savoy". Now, Benny come up one night and he heard us playing. He was looking around -- See, like Benny, like Artie, and like a lot of the white bands, they had their eye on Chick's band because the band was coming up. And we had a lot of good music. And Fletcher Henderson was on the road at that time, because we ran across Fletcher on the road. We played with him up there in Milwaukee somewhere, you know. Chick had a lot of

Fletcher's music. We wasn't going to play what Fletcher was going to play. We would play something else.
When we met him, we just said we ain't going to play his top things, because he had a lot of "Kip Porter Stomp" (inaudible) we had got from Fletcher. Chick would play other things, you know.

When we were at the Savoy, we would play all these things on a Saturday night. These musicians would come up Sunday -- mostly on a Saturday night when they figure the band is going to be really rocking, you know.
So Benny come up and he heard us play "Stompin At The Savoy". So he (inaudible) -- I'm over on the side about 11.30 talking to Benny (inaudible) play one night.
He say, "I like that song." I say, "Yeah."
And this is later. This is like in '37. The band is really coming up. We had made another tour.
The band is getting real heavy, I'm into the band now, we're doing things. We're getting
